text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan just got back from her
break, but
for whatever reason, she's
staring at me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just checking whether you forgot
about me
while I was away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Am I showing up properly in your lens,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's good, because I'll be getting back
to my
hard work and I don't want you to
miss it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan sounds like she's in a
good mood.
She must be well rested.
